messages:
frank: Heads-up — billing export shows ~4.5k extra embed rows on INV-23077 for customer QuantileAI. Looks like a vendor aggregator retry loop during a brief network flap. tagging @leila @mark

leila: Can you paste the invoice window and any sample request_ids? Also seeing billing-bot alert.

billing-bot: ALERT: embed_spike | customer=quantileai-57 | window=2028-01-20T15:10:00Z..2028-01-20T15:40:00Z | delta=4478 | confidence=0.94

mark: Quick triage: vendor=edge-agg-eu did a reconnect at ~15:12Z. We often see duplicate ingest when ack isn't idempotent. Run this to sample duplicates: ```sql
SELECT request_id, payload_hash, aggregator_node, timestamp
FROM embeds.ingest_raw
WHERE customer_id='quantileai-57' AND timestamp BETWEEN '2028-01-20T15:10:00Z' AND '2028-01-20T15:40:00Z'
ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 200;
```

leila: Pulled sample—lots of identical payload_hash with different request_id and aggregator_node switching eu->us-east within 2s. Looks like the aggregator retried without preserving idempotency key.

frank: Finance calc: 4478 * $0.18 = $805. => provisional credit request for $810 to cover rounding. Need finance sign-off before CS tells customer.

ops-bot: ACTION: schedule_backfill | job=bf-4481 | window=2028-01-20T15:10:00Z..2028-01-20T15:40:00Z | target=dedupe_mark_non_billable

mark: Ops plan: (1) targeted backfill to mark duplicate rows non-billable using payload_hash fingerprint, (2) ask vendor to add idempotency header, (3) verification job to produce reconciled csv. Backfill ETA 2-3 hours.

leila: I approve provisional credit up to $810 to avoid escalation. Please create billing_journal entry: invoice=INV-23077 amt=810.00 reason="vendor aggregator retry duplicates - provisional" and cc finance lead.

cara-cs: CS asks to message the customer: "We've applied a provisional credit while we investigate duplicate events caused by a vendor retry loop. We'll follow up with a reconciliation report." They want timeline in the message.

frank: Approved. Ops please post job id when backfill runs and attach reconciled diff CSV for ledger finalization.

mark: Backfill started job bf-4481 at 2028-01-20T16:05:12Z. Will post completion and reconciled delta. Also opening vendor ticket VND-9009 and requesting idempotency header.

leila: Finance: hold final ledger adjustment until reconciled output attached. Provisional credit created and tagged INV-23077.

cara-cs: I'll notify customer with provisional copy and estimated 3hr window. Thanks team. :pray:
